title: Shape detective
_map: Shape detective (Y1). Big idea: naming 2D and 3D shapes. Creative: build an animal using only squares, circles and triangles.
_story: The robot made a picture of the farm cat out of shapes. Ismaeel finds each shape, names it, then makes his own animal.
_stepChain: shapes have names → triangle (3 sides), square (4 equal sides), circle (no corners) → find them in the cat → 3D shapes are solid: cube, sphere → make your own animal

talk.goodAnswer: a circle head, triangle ears, a square body, rectangle legs and tail.

talk.ask: What's the difference between a square and a cube?
talk.goodAnswer: a square is flat; a cube is solid, made of 6 squares.

handsOn: Cut out paper squares, circles and triangles. Make an animal from only those shapes. What would you call it?

narration.speaker: robot
narration.text: Look! I made a picture of the farm cat, using only shapes. Can you be a shape detective and find them?
The ears have 3 straight sides and 3 corners. A shape like that is called a triangle.
The body has 4 straight sides, all the same length, and 4 corners. That's a square.
And the head is perfectly round.

question.prompt: How many corners does a circle have?
question.onRight: Yes. A circle is one curved line, with no corners at all.

0.mistake: thinks the place where you start drawing is a corner
0.hint: Run your finger round a circle. Do you ever hit a pointy bit?
0.say: A circle is one smooth curve, with no pointy bits. So it has zero corners.

2.say: 4 corners is a square. A circle is round all the way, so it has zero corners.

question.reveal: A circle has no corners and no straight sides.

narration.speaker: robot
narration.text: Now it's your turn. Make an animal using only squares, circles and triangles! A triangle beak? Circle eyes? Square wings? Show a grown-up your creature.

rule.text: Triangle: 3 sides. Square: 4 sides. Circle: no corners.
rule.ask: Can you say how many sides a triangle has, and a square? Say it out loud. Then tap the eye.
rule.spoken: A triangle has 3 sides and 3 corners. A square has 4 equal sides and 4 corners. A circle has no corners at all.

bonus.prompt: Bonus: a shape with 6 sides is called a hexagon. Where might you see one?
bonus.reveal: Bees build honeycomb out of hexagons! Footballs and pencils can have hexagons too.
